mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BLOCKLIST SET source_history_block_idx = #{sourceHistoryBlockIdx}, block_request_id = #{blockRequestId}, reason = #{reason}, is_active = #{active}, snapshot_status = #{snapshotStatus}, blocked_by_user_idx = #{blockedByUserIdx}, blocked_at = #{blockedAt}, released_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, released_at = #{releasedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_history_at = #{lastHistoryAt}, synced_at = #{syncedAt}, updated_by_user_idx = #{updatedByUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_idx = #{blockIdx}

UPDATE USER_BLOCKLIST SET is_active = #{active}, snapshot_status = #{snapshotStatus}, released_at = CASE WHEN #{active} THEN NULL ELSE NOW() END, released_by_user_idx = CASE WHEN #{active} THEN NULL ELSE #{releasedByUserIdx} END, last_history_at = NOW(), synced_at = NOW(), updated_by_user_idx = #{releasedByUserIdx}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_target_key = #{blockTargetKey}
